lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Shall we go on a hike on Sunday?
lines.audioText: Shall we go on a hike on Sunday?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’d like that. What does the forecast say?

lines.translation: Eu gostaria. O que diz a previsão?

pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: At nine. If we miss it, we can take the next one at nine thirty

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: All right. I’ll bring a raincoat. What about lunch?

pages.title: Make a plan B
pages.instruction: Agree on Plan A and Plan B, including what you’ll do if something changes

pages.title: Use the backup plan
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! The forecast says it will rain on Sunday morning. Let’s use our backup plan. If it rains, we’ll go straight to the museum, and we’ll have lunch inside. We can still take the nine o’clock bus. If that bus is late, let’s wait for the nine thirty one rather than walk in the rain. Does that work for you?
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! The forecast says it will rain on Sunday morning. Let’s use our backup plan. If it rains, we’ll go straight to the museum, and we’ll have lunch inside. We can still take the nine o’clock bus. If that bus is late, let’s wait for the nine thirty one rather than walk in the rain. Does that work for you?
pages.greeting: I have an update for you!
